provider_documentation.lrate: 누수확율 (leak rate): over a two-hour early-morning window each day the sensor checks for a leak 10 times; the share of checks whose response exceeds a set threshold is reported as a probability. Generated automatically by the leak-detection sensor. Integer 0-90.
provider_documentation.llevel: 누수레벨 (leak level): mean magnitude of the above-threshold responses in the same 10 checks. Generated automatically by the sensor. Integer 0-5000.
provider_documentation.flagged_classes: out, in, noise, other: assigned by a field leak-survey expert to sensors on which a leak had been DETECTED (flagged) by the sensor (technical report, Table 3).
provider_documentation.normal_class: normal: 'leak-detection records of service pipes on which a leak was NOT detected' (technical report, Table 3), i.e. records the sensor did not flag; not field-surveyed.
provider_documentation.acquisition_window: daily, two hours in the early morning (10 checks)
provider_documentation.documented_size: technical report 30,000 records; AI-Hub page 50,000; distributed copy 70,384
provider_documentation.spectral_columns_documented: '512 columns', listed as item 1 = 0 Hz ... item 512 = 5,120 Hz at 10 Hz; 0-5,120 Hz with both ends is 513 positions

reading: consistent with provider documentation: lrate = 90 for flagged records, < 90 for normal; no separation of leak vs noise or out vs in
